scope: Tryptic peptides were dissolved in NETN buffer (100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris-HCl, 0.5% NP-40, pH 8.0) and then incubated with pre-washed antibody beads (PTM Biolabs, Hangzhou, China) at 4 °C overnight with mild shaking.
